##### SECTION M2 (stale resume tokens (incremental source destroyed, target destroyed/recreated, sender renamed))  tag=C  zfs-2.4.1-1ubuntu5.1
=== CASE M2/i_from_destroyed.0a_base
--- cmd
zfs send -L -c zfsbcapc/M2/s/i_from_destroyed@a | zfs receive -u zfsbcapc/M2/r/i_from_destroyed

0

0 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
=== END
=== CASE M2/i_from_destroyed.0_recv_cut
--- cmd

1

--- stdout
--- stderr

=== END
